_comment: Run parameters for bpo-npi-observation-planner. CLI flags override.
_gsheet_id_help: Target Google Sheet id for the BPO hand-off. Leave empty to force --no-publish. The historical SNPE/WAW hand-off sheet was 19UAkSYujxgFDz39IBMexUFXKs_nxU5yAmGFKONDqivo.
_regen_help: Step 0 route generation. regenerate_routes=false consumes the vendored snapshot (fast, default). Set true to rebuild the coverage curves from the vendored demand CSV first. regenerate_scope: 'targets' rebuilds only the airports in targets.csv (fast); 'all' rebuilds every airport in the demand CSV. Snapshots are written to config/routes_<demand_snapshot_date>/ and config/demand_lut_<demand_snapshot_date>/.
_regenerate_full_exclusion_help: false (default) reproduces the shipped curves exactly: routes use the 15-entry route-gen coord table (config/airport_coords_routegen.json), so ~178 airports keep no airport-terminal hex exclusion, matching the published snapshot. Set true to apply the complete airport-terminal exclusion (config/airport_coords.json) to routes too — the corrected refresh, which CHANGES ~178 airports' curves.
